title: Visit to Saidpur Fecal Sludge Treatment Plant | Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur
content:
𝗙𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗹-𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿 𝘀𝘁𝘂𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀 of the 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗕𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧, 𝗦𝗮𝗶𝗱𝗽𝘂𝗿, visited the 𝗦𝗮𝗶𝗱𝗽𝘂𝗿 𝗙𝗲𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝗹𝘂𝗱𝗴𝗲 𝗧𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗣𝗹𝗮𝗻𝘁 (𝗙𝗦𝗧𝗣) on 𝟵 𝗦𝗲𝗽𝘁𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲, accompanied by faculty members, including 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗳. 𝗗𝗿. 𝗠𝗱. 𝗠𝗮𝗵𝗺𝘂𝗱𝘂𝗹 𝗛𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗻, 𝗛𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗗𝗲𝗮𝗻 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗙𝗮𝗰𝘂𝗹𝘁𝘆.
The visit aimed to connect students’ 𝗮𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗰 𝗸𝗻𝗼𝘄𝗹𝗲𝗱𝗴𝗲 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗹-𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱 𝗽𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗲, providing practical exposure to 𝗳𝗲𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝘀𝗹𝘂𝗱𝗴𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁, 𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻, 𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁, 𝗰𝗼-𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗼𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴, and 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆, particularly in relation to 𝗖𝗘 𝟰𝟭𝟰𝟭: 𝗪𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗲𝘄𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗦𝗮𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻. During the visit, students observed the plant’s treatment units and learned about the 𝗰𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻, 𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁, and 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝗲𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝘀𝗹𝘂𝗱𝗴𝗲.
Operational since 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟭, the plant is managed under 𝗦𝗮𝗶𝗱𝗽𝘂𝗿 𝗠𝘂𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗶𝗽𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, with technical support from 𝗕𝗔𝗦𝗔 𝗙𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 and 𝗪𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗔𝗶𝗱. It can treat up to 𝟮𝟲 𝗺³ 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝗲𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝘀𝗹𝘂𝗱𝗴𝗲 𝗱𝗮𝗶𝗹𝘆 and produces approximately 𝟭𝟯𝟮 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰 𝘁𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗼𝗿𝗴𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗰 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝗮𝗻𝗻𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆. The facility also incorporates 𝘀𝗼𝗹𝗮𝗿 𝗽𝗼𝘄𝗲𝗿 and 𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻𝘄𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗵𝗮𝗿𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴, contributing to sustainable sanitation and waste management in Saidpur.
The visit strengthened students’ understanding of 𝗽𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝘀𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝘄𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁, 𝗼𝗿𝗴𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗰 𝗳𝗲𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘇𝗲𝗿 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻, and 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆.

title: Academic Result Analysis | 6 September, 2026
content:
The faculty members of the 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗕𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧, 𝗦𝗮𝗶𝗱𝗽𝘂𝗿, held a meeting with the 𝗛𝗼𝗻𝗼𝗿𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗩𝗶𝗰𝗲 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗿, 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗴 𝗚𝗲𝗻 𝗠𝗼𝗵𝗮𝗺𝗺𝗮𝗱 𝗠𝗼𝗯𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗸 𝗛𝗼𝘀𝘀𝗮𝗶𝗻 𝗠𝗮𝗷𝘂𝗺𝗱𝗲𝗿, 𝗽𝘀𝗰, to review the department’s 𝗮𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗰 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲, 𝗰𝗼𝘂𝗿𝘀𝗲 𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘀, and areas requiring further improvement.
The discussion focused on strengthening 𝗮𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗰 𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆, enhancing 𝗰𝗼𝘂𝗿𝘀𝗲 𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘀, and ensuring 𝗯𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗴𝘂𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘀𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 for students. These collaborative efforts reflect the department’s commitment to 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗻𝘂𝗼𝘂𝘀 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗿𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 and fostering a more 𝗲𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗲𝗻𝘃𝗶𝗿𝗼𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁.

title: Official Announcement: Faculty Advisory Board (Summer 2026)
content:
The Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC), Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, is deeply honored to announce its Faculty Advisory Board for the Summer 2026 session.

title: বিএইউএসটি, সৈয়দপুরে ১৯তম একাডেমিক কাউন্সিল সভা অনুষ্ঠিত সৈয়দপুর, নীলফামারী
content:
সৈয়দপুরে অবস্থিত বাংলাদেশ আর্মি ইউনিভার্সিটি অব সায়েন্স এন্ড টেকনোলজি (বিএইউএসটি), সৈয়দপুর এর একাডেমিক কাউন্সিলের ১৯তম সভা আজ ২৪ আগস্ট ২০২৬ (সোমবার) সকাল ১০:০০টায় বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের সভাকক্ষে অনুষ্ঠিত হয়েছে।
সভায় সভাপতিত্ব করেন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের মাননীয় উপাচার্য ব্রিগেডিয়ার জেনারেল মোহাম্মদ মোবারক হোসেন মজুমদার, পিএসসি। সভার শুরুতে সভাপতি মহোদয় স্বাগত বক্তব্য প্রদান করেন। এরপর বিদায়ী সদস্যকে ধন্যবাদ জ্ঞাপন এবং নবনিযুক্ত সদস্যদের অভিনন্দন জানানো হয়। পাশাপাশি ১৮তম সভার কার্যবিবরণী নিশ্চিত করা হয়।
১৯তম সভায় মোট ১৬টি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ আলোচ্যসূচি নিয়ে বিস্তারিত আলোচনা করা হয়। একাডেমিক কার্যক্রমের উন্নয়ন, শিক্ষার মানোন্নয়ন, পাঠ্যক্রম সংক্রান্ত বিষয় এবং প্রশাসনিক বিভিন্ন দিক নিয়ে সভায় গঠনমূলক আলোচনা অনুষ্ঠিত হয়।
২১ সদস্যবিশিষ্ট এ কমিটির সভাপতি হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন উপাচার্য ব্রিগেডিয়ার জেনারেল মোহাম্মদ মোবারক হোসেন মজুমদার, পিএসসি। সম্মানিত সদস্য হিসেবে উপস্থিত ছিলেন ব্রিগেডিয়ার জেনারেল মোঃ মাহবুবুল হক, এনডিসি, এএফডব্লিউসি, পিএসসি, কমান্ড্যান্ট, ইএমই সেন্টার এন্ড স্কুল, সৈয়দপুর সেনানিবাস। সভায় সদস্য সচিব হিসেবে দায়িত্ব পালন করেন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের রেজিস্ট্রার কর্নেল চৌধুরী সাইফ উদ্দিন কাউসার, পিবিজিএম (অবঃ)।
এছাড়াও বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের সকল অনুষদের ডীনবৃন্দ, বিভাগীয় প্রধানগণ ও জৈষ্ঠ্যতার ভিত্তিতে সিএসই বিভাগের একজন অধ্যাপক সভায় সদস্য হিসেবে অংশগ্রহণ করেন।
চারজন এক্সটার্নাল সদস্য অনলাইনের মাধ্যমে সভায় যুক্ত ছিলেন। তারা হলেন—
অধ্যাপক ড. মোহাম্মদ আলী (এমই বিভাগ, বুয়েট), অধ্যাপক ড. মুহাম্মদ মাসরুর আলী (সিএসই বিভাগ, বুয়েট), অধ্যাপক ড. মোঃ আয়নাল হক (ইইই বিভাগ, বুয়েট) এবং অধ্যাপক ড. মোহাম্মদ তৌফিকুল ইসলাম (ব্যবস্থাপনা বিভাগ, ঢাকা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়)।
সভায় গৃহীত সিদ্ধান্তসমূহ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের একাডেমিক কার্যক্রমকে আরও গতিশীল ও মানসম্মত করতে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা রাখবে বলে আশা প্রকাশ করা হয়।

title: Practical Field Survey for the Proposed G+6 Administrative Building at BAUST, Saidpur
content:
The 𝗗𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝗖𝗶𝘃𝗶𝗹 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴, 𝗕𝗔𝗨𝗦𝗧, 𝗦𝗮𝗶𝗱𝗽𝘂𝗿 conducted a practical field survey at the proposed site of the 𝗚+𝟲 𝗔𝗱𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗕𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 at the new campus.
The field survey provided 𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐮𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬 with a valuable opportunity to gain hands-on experience in 𝘀𝘂𝗿𝘃𝗲𝘆𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗹𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴, bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and real-world engineering practice. The students received practical training in the use of an 𝗮𝘂𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗰 𝗹𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹, including instrument setup and operation, leveling procedures, staff reading, the use of ranging rods, and other essential field surveying techniques.
Throughout the survey, 𝘁𝗵𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗮𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗰 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘁𝘀 and members of the 𝘁𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗺 provided guidance and technical support, ensuring the successful execution of the surveying and leveling activities.
Such practical field exposure enhances students’ 𝘁𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲, 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗳𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲, and 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗳𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴, preparing them for the challenges of real-world civil engineering practice.

content:

title: Strengthening Academia–Industry Collaboration
content:
The 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐁𝐀𝐔𝐒𝐓, 𝐒𝐚𝐢𝐝𝐩𝐮𝐫, was honored to welcome 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐫. 𝐓𝐚𝐬𝐧𝐢𝐚 𝐓𝐚𝐬𝐦𝐢𝐦 𝐒𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚, Sub-Divisional Engineer, 𝐑𝐨𝐚𝐝𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐇𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐰𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐃𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 (𝐑𝐇𝐃), Nilphamari.
As the Industry Advisor of the industrial attachment course, Engr. Tasnia Tasmim Sinthia made a courtesy visit to the high officials of BAUST, including the 𝐕𝐢𝐜𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐨𝐫 𝐁𝐫𝐢𝐠 𝐆𝐞𝐧 𝐌𝐨𝐡𝐚𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐝 𝐌𝐨𝐛𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐤 𝐇𝐨𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐌𝐚𝐣𝐮𝐦𝐝𝐞𝐫, 𝐑𝐞𝐠𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐫 𝐂𝐨𝐥 𝐂𝐡𝐨𝐰𝐝𝐡𝐮𝐫𝐲 𝐒𝐚𝐢𝐟 𝐔𝐝𝐝𝐢𝐧 𝐊𝐚𝐰𝐬𝐚𝐫, 𝐏𝐁𝐆𝐌, 𝐒𝐢𝐠𝐬 (𝐑𝐞𝐭𝐝), 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐃𝐞𝐚𝐧 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐟. 𝐃𝐫. 𝐌𝐝. 𝐌𝐚𝐡𝐦𝐮𝐝𝐮𝐥 𝐇𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐧.
During the visit, the Dean, Faculty of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur presented a token of appreciation to her in recognition of her valuable time, dedicated mentorship, professional guidance, and sincere support throughout the students’ industrial attachment.
Her involvement provided the students with an important connection between academic learning and real-world engineering practice. The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur sincerely appreciates her contribution and remains committed to fostering strong academia–industry collaboration to prepare competent, confident, and industry-ready civil engineers.

title: Final Presentation and Viva of the Industrial Attachment Course (CE 4170) | Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur
content:
The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur, successfully concluded the Final Presentation and Viva of the Industrial Attachment Course (CE 4170) for the 𝐋𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥-𝟒, 𝐓𝐞𝐫𝐦-𝐈 students of the 𝐂𝐄 𝟏𝟕𝐭𝐡 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡, titled “Bridging Theory and Practice: Insights from Industrial Attachment.”
The 𝐭𝐰𝐨-𝐰𝐞𝐞𝐤 𝐈𝐧𝐝𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐚𝐥 𝐀𝐭𝐭𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 concluded with students presenting their key learnings and professional experiences gained from three major government organizations: the Roads and Highways Department (RHD), Public Works Department (PWD), and Bangladesh Water Development Board (BWDB).
The program was graced by the presence of 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐟. 𝐃𝐫. 𝐌𝐝. 𝐌𝐚𝐡𝐦𝐮𝐝𝐮𝐥 𝐇𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐧, Dean, Faculty of Civil Engineering, Lecturer Ahasanul Haque Hashib, Industrial Attachment Coordinator, respected Industry Advisor, faculty members, and students of the department.
Prof. Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan and the Industry Advisor, Tanisa Tasmim Sinthia, SDE, RHD, Nilphamari, shared valuable insights and guidance with the students, emphasizing technical competence, professional ethics, continuous learning, and practical problem-solving skills.
The Department sincerely appreciates the Industry Advisor, faculty members, coordinators, and students for their valuable contributions in making the program successful.

The ceremony was graced by the presence of 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐟. 𝐃𝐫. 𝐌𝐝. 𝐌𝐚𝐡𝐦𝐮𝐝𝐮𝐥 𝐇𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐧, Dean, Faculty of Civil Engineering and head of the Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur along with respected faculty members and our distinguished alumni.
The tournament was officially inaugurated by Hon’ble Dean Sir with the first batting of the tournament. In his address, he emphasized the importance of engaging in regular sports and physical activities alongside academic pursuits.
Following the inauguration, 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐞𝐱𝐜𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐩-𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐬 were successfully conducted by the organizers, bringing together students, faculty members, and alumni in an atmosphere of enthusiasm and camaraderie.
It was truly a wonderful day filled with sportsmanship, excitement, teamwork, and thrilling moments. We look forward to many more memorable matches in the days ahead!

The Department of Civil Engineering, Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST), Saidpur, organized a combined Orientation Program for the 23rd Batch, Farewell Program for the 15th Batch, and Prize Giving Ceremony for 100% Class Attendance on 16 August, 2026 at the Seminar Hall.
The program was graced by 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐟𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐨𝐫 𝐃𝐫. 𝐌𝐝. 𝐌𝐚𝐡𝐦𝐮𝐝𝐮𝐥 𝐇𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐧, Dean, Faculty of Civil Engineering as the Chief Guest.

Representatives of the batch shared their feelings, expectations, and positive first impressions of the department, expressing confidence in the supportive academic environment and guidance of their teachers and seniors.
The 𝟏𝟓𝐭𝐡 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡, marking the completion of their undergraduate journey, shared heartfelt experiences and gratitude toward the department. They advised their juniors to remain attentive in class, develop practical knowledge, strengthen their technical skills, and learn relevant engineering software to prepare themselves for a successful professional career. Farewell crests were presented to the graduating students as a token of appreciation and remembrance.
A total of 𝟏𝟒 𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬 were recognized for achieving 𝟏𝟎𝟎% 𝐜𝐥𝐚𝐬𝐬 𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 and received certificates and prizes in appreciation of their discipline, commitment, and dedication to academic life. One of the awardees shared their experience, highlighting how regular attendance contributes to better understanding of courses, stronger relationships with peers, and greater confidence in academic activities.
In speech, the Chief Guest Prof. Dr. Mahmud welcomed the new students and encouraged them to focus on academic excellence while developing discipline, integrity, ethical values, and professional responsibility. He reminded the graduating students that knowledge and skills must always be accompanied by honesty and moral values, particularly in civil engineering, where professional decisions directly affect people’s safety and the nation’s infrastructure.
Finally the program concluded with a joyful photo session, capturing memorable moments of the day. Special thanks to our students, Md. Jahid Hasan (Level 4, Term II) and Samprite Saha (Level 3, Term I), for their excellent anchoring and enthusiastic contribution to the program.

title: Building Future Engineers: Thesis Pre-Defense Session Held at BAUST, Civil Engineering Department
content:
The Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur, successfully conducted the 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝐏𝐫𝐞-𝐃𝐞𝐟𝐞𝐧𝐬𝐞 for the students of the 4-I Semester. This important academic event provided a platform for students to present their research ideas and proposed thesis plans before faculty members and fellow students.
During the session, the faculty members offered valuable feedback, constructive criticism, and expert guidance to help students refine their research methodologies and strengthen the quality of their work for future publications and real-world applications.
The proposed research topics showcased the students’ commitment to addressing contemporary engineering and environmental challenges, including:
1. Groundwater potential mapping using GIS in Nilphamari District to support future water resource planning amid rapid urbanization.
2. Sustainable utilization of recycled ceramic tiles in concrete production to reduce environmental impacts and promote greener construction practices.
3. Investigation of natural soil as landfill liner material to prevent groundwater contamination from waste leachate.
4. Eco-friendly pavement construction using jute fiber as a sustainable reinforcement material.
5. Numerical simulation of soil-structure interaction under earthquake loading for resilient infrastructure development.
6. Assessment of seismic performance of buildings with soft-story irregularities caused by open parking floors.
7. Recycling and reuse of asphalt pavement materials for sustainable transportation infrastructure.
The Department proudly applauds the enthusiasm, creativity, and research potential demonstrated by the students. We extend our sincere appreciation to 𝐃𝐫. 𝐌𝐝. content:
A seminar on earthquake risk and mitigation was held at Bangladesh Army University of Science and Technology (BAUST), Saidpur, on Wednesday, 20 May. The seminar, titled “Earthquake Risk Scenario: Bangladesh Perspective, BNBC-2020 and Mitigation Measure,” was organized by the Department of Civil Engineering at the university’s seminar hall.
The chief guest of the program was Brig Gen Mohammad Mobarak Hossain Majumder, psc, Honorable Vice Chancellor, BAUST, Saidpur. The session was chaired by Assoc. Prof. Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan, Dean (In-charge) and Head, Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Saidpur.
The keynote presentation was delivered by Prof. Tahmeed M. Al-Hussaini, Civil Engg. Dept., BUET, and President of the Bangladesh Earthquake Society. He discussed earthquake risks in Bangladesh, key provisions of BNBC-2020, and various disaster mitigation strategies in detail. He also highlighted major earthquake events in Nepal, Turkey, Syria, and Japan, emphasizing Bangladesh’s potential vulnerability and the importance of preparedness. He also emphasized that unplanned urbanization and poor construction practices significantly increase seismic risks in Bangladesh. He stressed the necessity of strictly following BNBC-2020, ensuring the use of quality construction materials, and developing skilled engineers to reduce earthquake-related risks and losses.
In his remarks, the chief guest stated that Bangladesh lies in a seismically vulnerable region and therefore greater awareness is essential at all levels. He highlighted that disaster impacts can be significantly reduced through modern technology, research, and sound engineering practices. He also appreciated the initiative of the Civil Engineering Department and encouraged students to gain more practical, field-oriented knowledge.
The Chairperson thanked the invited guests, faculty members, and students for their participation. He expressed hope that the discussions from the seminar would play an important role in enhancing the professional competence and awareness of future engineers.
The seminar was attended by the university Registrar, Treasurer, Controller of Examinations, along with faculty members and more than one hundred Civil Engineering students.
Later, a low-cost earthquake monitoring device, known as a “low-cost accelerometer,” was installed on campus as part of modern seismic observation technology being introduced in selected areas of the country.

title: Collaborating for Empowering Youth: BAUST Faculty and Student Join Futurenation’s Skill Development Workshop
content:
On Thursday, September 18, 2025, two of our faculty members (Faisal Ahmed from the Civil Engineering (CE) Department and Rezaul Karim from the Accounting and Information Systems (AIS) Department) and a fourth-year student participated in the Regional Skilled Hub Workshop in Rangpur. Hosted by Futurenation, a subsidiary of United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), and sponsored by the Bangladesh Investment Development Authority (BIDA) and Grameenphone, the event focused on empowering the nation’s youth through free skill-development programs.

Our faculty members, Faisal Ahmed from the Civil Engineering (CE) Department and Rezaul Karim from the Accounting and Information Systems (AIS) Department, joined a fourth-year student to represent our institution. They engaged with fellow faculty and students from across the Rangpur division to discuss how to improve and expand these vital training initiatives.

Futurenation’s mission is to provide free training in key areas such as freelancing, graphic design, and English speaking, alongside workshops aimed at building leadership and teamwork abilities. The workshop provided an excellent platform for participants to share insights on overcoming challenges and making these programs more accessible nationwide.

This event was also a fantastic networking opportunity, allowing our representatives to connect with peers from various institutions and contribute to a larger conversation about shaping a more skilled and prepared workforce for Bangladesh’s future. We’re proud to have been a part of this important discussion.

title: Dr. Md Mahmudul Hasan Addresses ‘Polythene Bag Pollution and Our Environment’ at “Tarunner Uthshab 2025” Closing Ceremony
content:
Dr. Md Mahmudul Hasan Addresses ‘Polythene Bag Pollution and Our Environment’ at “Tarunner Uthshab 2025” Closing Ceremony:
Our esteemed Dean (In charge) of the Faculty of Civil Engineering and Head of the Department of Civil Engineering, BAUST, Associate Professor Dr. Md Mahmudul Hasan, delivered an inspiring and thought-provoking lecture at the closing ceremony of Tarunner Uthshab 2025, a month-long event organized by the BAIUST Civil Engineering Club, BAIUST, Cumilla.

As the guest of honor and keynote speaker, Dr. Mahmud captivated the audience with his powerful 45-minute speech on the pressing issue of “Polythene Bag Pollution and Our Environment.”

Dr. Mahmud discussed the severe consequences of polythene bag pollution, emphasizing its detrimental impact on soil health, water bodies, marine ecosystems, and public health. He elaborated on how non-biodegradable polythene bags clog drainage systems, increase flood risk, contaminate food chains, and contribute significantly to climate change. Additionally, he outlined practical steps to combat these challenges, including initiatives the Bangladesh government took to reduce plastic pollution.

A Bold Initiative: Making BAIUST a Polythene-Free Campus:
During his speech, Dr. Mahmud encouraged students to transform BAIUST into the first polythene bag-free university campus in Bangladesh by July 3, 2025, in alignment with International Plastic Bag Free Day. He emphasized that achieving this goal would be a landmark achievement in Bangladesh’s environmental movement, setting an example for other institutions to follow.

Dr. Mahmud expressed his gratitude to the Department of Civil Engineering, BAIUST, for selecting him for this prestigious program and acknowledged their efforts to raise environmental sustainability awareness.

The event concluded with a strong commitment from students and faculty to support this initiative and work towards a greener future.

title: Popsicle Truss Bridge Competition organized by the Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC)
content:
The Civil Engineering Department at BAUST made history by hosting its inaugural Truss Bridge Competition on September 21, 2024. Organized by the Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC), the event was a platform for students to showcase their engineering prowess. A total of 13 enthusiastic teams participated, each bringing their uniquely designed truss bridge to the competition. The atmosphere was filled with excitement as students combined creativity with technical knowledge to construct bridges capable of bearing impressive loads. Held at 3:30 PM, the event demonstrated the practical application of theoretical concepts learned in the classroom.

The teams were judged on various criteria, including the efficiency and durability of their bridges under stress. As the competition progressed, the increasing load tests pushed the boundaries of what these young engineers had envisioned. This hands-on experience not only tested their structural understanding but also emphasized teamwork, problem-solving, and time management. Each team’s effort was a clear reflection of their dedication and preparation leading up to the competition.

Faculty members, including advisors from the CEIC, played an instrumental role in guiding the students throughout the process. The event also attracted spectators from across the university, eager to witness the creative engineering solutions on display. The participants took pride in their work, knowing that this competition was a stepping stone to future professional challenges.

The truss bridge competition at BAUST symbolizes the university’s commitment to practical learning and innovation in engineering. It also highlighted the importance of extracurricular activities that enhance technical skills. For many, the event was not only a competition but a learning experience that will inspire them in their future careers. This remarkable initiative by the CEIC is set to become a tradition in the years to come.

মাননীয় ভাইস চ্যান্সেলর ব্রি. জে. সানোয়ার উদ্দিন স্যার এবং প্রাক্তন ভাইস চ্যান্সেলর ব্রি. জে. মো: লুৎফর রহমান স্যার এর উপস্থিতিতে উদ্বোধন করা হয় আমাদের “পিঠা মহল” এর। অন্যান্য দপ্তর প্রধান, ডিন মহোদয় ও বিভাগীয় প্রধানগণের সাথে হরেক রকম পিঠার স্বাদ গ্রহণ করেন ভিসি স্যার এবং অতিথিবৃন্দ
পুরকৌশল বিভাগের আতিথেয়তায়ও মুগ্ধ হন তারা
পিঠা পরিবেশন, আপ্যায়ন, সাংস্কৃতিক অনুষ্ঠান, গল্প-গুজব আর আড্ডায় জাকজমোকপূর্ণভাবে অতিবাহিত হয় পুরো সন্ধ্যা, সেই সাথে আয়োজন করা হয় সাংস্কৃতিক অনুষ্ঠানের
দিনশেষে প্রত্যেক বিভাগের পিঠা উৎসব এর আয়োজন, উদযাপন ও আপ্যায়নসহ নানাবিধ বিষয় বিবেচনায় রেখে কর্তৃপক্ষের সিদ্ধান্ত মতে পুরকৌশল বিভাগের “পিঠা মহল” এবং সিএসই বিভাগের “বসন্তবৌরী” কে যৌথভাবে “বেস্ট স্টল” এর স্বীকৃতি দেওয়া হয়
উল্লেখ্য যে, গত ২০২৩ সালের পিঠা উৎসব অনুষ্ঠানেও পুরকৌশল বিভাগ ইংলিশ বিভাগের সাথে যৌথভাবে প্রথম হয়েছিল
এইবারও সেই ধারাবাহিকতা বজায় রেখেছে আমাদের ডিপার্টমেন্ট এর শিক্ষার্থীরা
এই স্বীকৃতির নেপথ্যে ছিলো পুরকৌশল বিভাগের শিক্ষার্থীদের অক্লান্ত পরিশ্রম, ডেডিকেশন, ক্রিয়েটিভ চিন্তাধারা এবং সম্মানিত বিভাগীয় প্রধান স্যার এর দিকনির্দেশনা

content:
“Intra-Department Drawing & CAD Contest” organized by Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC) ,Dept. of CE

“Intra-Department Drawing & CAD Contest” was organized in Department of Civil Engineering by the Civil Engineering Innovation Club (CEIC) of BAUST on 04.02.2024. Several teams from the department did compete in this contest of preparing a well organized building plan on a given plot area.
Each team consisted of two students. They were directed to prepare a double unit building plan on a A-3 drawing sheet and using AutoCAD tool by fulfilling the given requirements. Each group used the collective knowledge of their team members to fulfill the task.

The result of this contest will be published very soon after proper technical and aesthetic evaluation.

title: Final Thesis Defence of the 1st Batch (10th Batch) of CE,BAUST
content:
After a year long experiment and research the students of CE 1st Batch (10th batch of BAUST Campus) finally presented their graduation thesis today. There were 14 students who presented their thesis in front of the board of internal and external supervisor’s.
Their thesis covered various aspects of Civil Engineering from Structural, Environmental and Transportation engineering sector.
They incorporated the local technical/engineering issues of north bengal and proposed feasible solution for them.
We believe that, their unique findings will help the scientific community as well as the local policy makers of north bengal to implement the fiscal measures.
The honorable head of the department Dr. Md. Mahmudul Hasan sir instructed all the students to publish their graduation thesis to a renowned journal within 2 months.
We believe that, our future students of Civil Engineering Department will also create meaningful research for the community using our state-of-the-art laboratory facilities at BAUST.
